title: Kutu (Cuthah), entrance to the underworld in Iraq
place_text: Tell Ibrahim, south-east of Baghdad, Iraq

tellings.quote: and it was a place that was supposed to be the entrance to the underworld. It exists today today in Iraq.

plain: An ancient place called Kutu, or Cuthah, was supposed to be the entrance to the underworld, and it still exists today in Iraq, at a site called Tell Ibrahim south-east of Baghdad. The researcher Peter Levenda says this without naming a source, linking it to the Necronomicon, a book of occult spells and lore. If he is right, a real spot on the map was once treated as a doorway to the land of the dead.
